title: Prakriti200: A Questionnaire-Based Dataset of 200 Ayurvedic Prakriti Assessments
reasoning: The paper focuses on a dataset for Ayurvedic Prakriti assessment for health analytics and machine learning. While Ayurveda is a traditional Indian system of knowledge, the paper treats it as a physiological and psychological framework for classification rather than evaluating or benchmarking religious beliefs, faith, or ethics.
